__chunk.title: What should I do if my Huawei phone keeps disconnecting from multi-camera or virtual keyboard?

answer.text: If you experience disconnections with multi-camera or virtual keyboard on Huawei phones, follow these steps:

items: In the search bar at the top, type 'App launch management'.
Go to the App launch management page and scroll down to find VicastCam.
Turn off the toggle on the right (icon turns gray), and in the popup, enable all three options (they turn blue).

answer.text: You can also refer to the video tutorial 'How to prevent disconnections with multi-camera and virtual keyboard on Huawei phones'.
